validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@example.com.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: We'll email you a code to confirm it's you.
signUp.name: Your name
signUp.invited: Invited to a list or a team? Sign up with the email the invitation went to.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {{email}}. It expires in 15 minutes.
verify.resent: We sent a new code to {{email}}.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a 6-digit code.
forgot.note: If there's an account with this email, the code arrives within a minute. Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: For {{email}}. You'll be signed in here; your other devices will be signed out.

unreachable.title: Can't reach Tasky
unreachable.body: Check your connection and try again. You're still signed in.

today.caughtUpNext: Nothing needs you today. Coming up has what is next.

browse.title: Browse
browse.editHint: Use the arrows to change your order. Teams stay A–Z.
browse.noMatch: No lists, teams or tags match “{{query}}”.
browse.myListsEmpty: Lists group your tasks: Home, Work, a trip. Tap + to make one.
browse.teamsEmpty: A team shares all its lists with its people: Family, Design.
browse.tagsEmpty: Tags cut across lists: #calls, #errands. Add them from a task.
browse.startBody: Your Inbox and lists, private until you share them
browse.teamGone: You’re no longer in this team.
browse.teamNoLists: No lists yet. Tap + to add one.
browse.peopleCanInvite: You can invite and remove people.
browse.peopleTeamOnly: The team’s owner and admins invite people.
browse.inviteTeamHint: They get an email and see every list in the team once they join. Invitations last 14 days.
browse.inviteListHint: They get an email and see this list once they join. Invitations last 14 days.

listSub.team: in every list of the team

listEmptyFor.tag: No open tasks with this tag.

browse.archivedSub: Finished lists: out of Browse and the pickers for everyone in them; their tasks stay searchable.
browse.deletedSub: Tasks, lists and teams you could see stay here for 30 days.
browse.deleteListBody_one: Its {{count}} open task goes with it. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days.
browse.deleteListBody_other: Its {{count}} open tasks go with it. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days.
browse.deleteSharedListBody_one: Its {{count}} open task goes with it, for everyone in it. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days.
browse.deleteSharedListBody_other: Its {{count}} open tasks go with it, for everyone in it. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days.
browse.deleteTeamBody: Its lists and their tasks go with it, for everyone. You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days.
browse.deleteTagBody: It comes off the tasks you can edit; the tasks stay.
browse.leaveListBody: It leaves your Browse; your tasks there are unassigned. {{name}} can invite you again.
browse.leaveTeamBody: Its lists leave your Browse; your tasks there are unassigned.
browse.alsoShared_one: Also changes {{count}} task other people see.
browse.alsoShared_other: Also changes {{count}} tasks other people see.

sheet.name: Name
sheet.tagHint: Letters, digits, _ and -, up to 30. The color is only yours.
sheet.teamHint: A team shares every list in it with its people. You’re its owner.
sheet.sameForAll: Name, color and sort are the same for everyone in this list.

search.title: Search
search.empty: Finds tasks by the words in their titles, notes and steps, open and completed, in everything you can see. Accents don’t matter.

tags.title: Tags
tags.empty: No tags yet. Type a name to create one.

errors.auth.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.email-not-verified: Verify your email before signing in. We sent you a code when you signed up.
errors.auth.account_deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your administrator.
errors.auth.account_setup_pending: Your account is still being set up. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't reach Tasky. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: Tasky is taking too long to answer. Try again.
errors.auth.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired. Check the latest email or ask for a new code.
errors.stale: This task changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept on the latest version; check them and save again.
errors.task.too_many_steps: A task can have at most 100 steps.
errors.task.completed: Reopen the task to add steps.
errors.tag.name_taken: There's already a tag with that name.

taskDetail.title: Title
taskDetail.discardMessage: Your edits to this task haven't been saved.
taskDetail.deleteMessage: You can restore it from Recently Deleted for 30 days.
taskDetail.rejectMessage: {{name}} is told, with your reason if you add one. The task stays in its list, unassigned.

repeat.hint: Repeats from the due date. With no due date, it starts today.

sub.attention: Invitations, assignments to answer, overdue tasks
sub.today: Due today, or with a reminder today
sub.important: All your important tasks, soonest first
sub.inbox: Tasks with no list or date yet

notifications.taskRescheduled: {{actor}} changed the due date of {{task}} to {{date}}

invitation.noteList: You'll see this list next to your own. Your own lists stay private.
invitation.noteTeam: You'll see every list in the team next to your own, now and future. Your own lists stay private.
invitation.declineMessage: Nobody is told. They can invite you again.
invitation.gone: This invitation is no longer open.

activity.title: Activity
activity.sub: Assignments, invitations and changes to your lists and teams
activity.emptyBody: When people share lists and teams with you, what they do for you shows here.
